name: Night light extras
author: DEADBOARD
description: An example mod that builds on other mods: a knowledge pack and a puzzle for the starter kit's night light, and one more note for the built-in Ghost Short challenge. No board files of its own.

hints: With power OFF, measure from TP2 (GND) to each side of F1. The open fuse splits the board: which side is shorted?
Follow the +5 V trace after the fuse: a hairline sliver of copper joins it to the ground trace beside it. Cut it with the knife.
Vout = 5 V × R2 / (R1 + R2). R1 is 10 kΩ.
Only replace the fuse after the short is gone: measure the +5 V side to ground again first.

patches.why: Example patch: a fourth note. Arrays replace, so the three original notes are listed too.

knowledge.title: Night light

checks.readsLowIf: the cells are flat or the holder's contacts are corroded

checks.expect: ≈1.8 V with SW1 pressed, 0 V released
checks.readsLowIf: SW1 doesn't close, or R1 is open or has a cold joint

rails.notes: A red LED drops about 1.8 V; R1 sets the current: (3.0 − 1.8) V / 68 Ω ≈ 18 mA.

notes: The current path: BT1 → SW1 → R1 → D1 → back to BT1. R2 is not fitted.

puzzles.title: Night light · barely glows
puzzles.description: The night light came back from a damp bathroom. Press the button and D1 hardly lights. The batteries are new.
hints: Measure the voltage across R1 with SW1 pressed, then work out the current. Is it what the knowledge pack says?
Power off and measure R1 itself. A corroded resistor can read far above its marking: replace it.
